# Ulla Dam-Schmidt

Ulla Dam-Schmidt is a nurse (sygeplejerske) with a clinical specialist function and an MKS qualification, employed at [[bispebjerg-og-frederiksberg-hospitaler|Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospitaler]][^src1][^src2][^src3]. She is a member of the leadership (formandsskabet) of the steering group for [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK), the Danish national quality registry for atrial fibrillation treatment[^src1].

Across the AFDK annual reports she appears consistently in a leadership role for the database. In the 2023 annual report, covering the period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023, she is named as part of the "Formandsskabet for Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark," the group that oversees the registry's steering committee, which in that report was chaired by Lars Frost. She is also listed among the database's chairpersons ("Forpersoner") in the section covering pages 81-85 of that report, described there with the fuller title "Sygeplejerske med klinisk specialfunktion, SD, MKS"[^src2]. In the 2024 annual report, covering 1 July 2023 to 30 June 2024, she is again listed as one of the "Forpersoner for databasen" (database chairpersons/leaders)[^src3], and she appears again in the section on patient representatives, structured patient education, and the steering group's membership (pages 66-70)[^src4].

Her repeated presence across both the 2023 and 2024 reports underscores her ongoing role in the governance of AFDK, a registry administered under the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) that tracks quality-of-care indicators — including anticoagulation treatment, echocardiography, TSH measurement, bleeding risk, and patient education — for atrial fibrillation patients treated at Danish hospitals and, since June 2023, by practicing cardiologists as well.
